headline: Photographer
summary: Photographer with three years in events, products and food photography around Caloocan and Quezon City. I shoot and edit in Lightroom and Photoshop, plan shot lists with clients, and deliver galleries quickly. I also manage my studio's social media page.

experience.title: Photographer
bullets: Shoot about six events a month: weddings, debuts, christenings and company outings.
Photograph products and menus for small food and clothing brands in the studio.
Edit and retouch galleries in Lightroom and Photoshop, delivering within a week.
Run the studio's Facebook and Instagram pages and answer booking enquiries.

experience.title: Photography Assistant
bullets: Set up lights and backdrops and managed client queues during school photo days.
Backed up and sorted photos after each shoot.

education.credential: Diploma in Photography and Digital Imaging
education.school: Metro North Institute of Visual Arts
